    <el:luamain><![CDATA[

wo["ConserveLevel"] = true
wo["GlobalForce"] = po(0.0, 40.0)

ti[" "] = {"fl_space"}
ti["."] = {"fl_samba"}
ti["#"] = {"st_brownpyramid"}

ti["B"] = ti{"#ac_pearl_white", "anchor2"}
ti["C"] = ti{"#ac_marble_white", "anchor3"}
ti["O"] = {"st_oxyd"}
ti["@"] = {"#ac_marble_black"} .. ti["."]

w, h = wo(ti, " ", {
 -- 01234567890123456789
   "...               O#",
   "...               ##",
   "...       B C     O#",
   "...               ##",
   "...               O#",
   "...               ##",
   "@..       A       ##",
   "...               ##",
   "...               O#",
   "...               ##",
   "...               O#",
   "...               ##",
   "...               O#",
})

wo:shuffleOxyd()

wo:add({"ot_rubberband", anchor1 = "anchor2", anchor2 = "anchor1", length = 4, min = 3.98, max = 4.01})
wo:add({"ot_rubberband", anchor1 = "anchor2", anchor2 = "anchor3", length = 2, min = 1.98, max = 2.01})

    ]]></el:luamain>

wo["ProvideExtralifes"] = false

ti["#"] = {"st_rawglass"}
ti["@"] = {"#ac_marble"}
ti["A"] = {"st_oneway_n"}
ti["B"] = ti["A"]..{"it_trigger",target="ammunition"}
ti["1"] = {"st_spitter"}
ti["O"] = {"st_oxyd_c"}
ti["P"] = cond(wo["IsDifficult"], ti["O"], ti["#"])

floor = {{"fl_ice"}, {"fl_rough"}, {"fl_mortar"}, {"fl_ice"}, {"fl_ice"}}

function snow(key, x, y)
    if key == " " then
      return floor[random(#floor)]
    else
      return ti[key]
    end
end

w, h = wo(snow, " ", {
         "#################",
         "#@    ###OOO#####",
         "#     1#PP#PP####",
         "#     ###OOO#####",
         "#     ###########",
         "#     #######   #",
         "# #B#####   # # #",
         "# #A#   # # # # #",
         "# # # # # # # # #",
         "# #   #   #   # #",
         "# ############# #",
         "#               #",
         "#################"})

function ammunition(value)
    if value then
        wo:add(YIN, {"it_extralife"})
        wo:add(YIN, {"it_extralife"})
        wo:add(YIN, {"it_extralife"})
        wo:add(YIN, {"it_extralife"})
        wo:add(YIN, {"it_extralife"})
        wo:add(YIN, {"it_extralife"})
    end
end
 ]]></el:luamain>
